jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, precise architectural game environment revision. Edit image 1, the main stage section of an actual 2D side-scrolling cyberpunk livehouse map. Image 2 is a crude GEOMETRY BLUEPRINT ONLY: replace ALL its flat polygons with finished pixel art; follow its perspective planes, sizes and vanishing edges. Image 1 determines the authentic pixel art style, hand-clustered scale, existing light exposure, materials and colors. One wide full-bleed 1792:635 aspect ratio image. The problem to fix is that the old band's stage looks flush against a flat wall. Carve a SUBSTANTIAL inward bay in the central rear wall, behind the walking lane. The player must immediately see an inner performing floor set back into the wall, recessed back wall and a distinct foreground route, even when no musicians or furniture are placed.
Architectural blocking precisely as in ref 2: outer dark steel proscenium opening from about x13.5% to 86.5%, from y12% to y70%. Recessed back wall only from x22% to 78%, top at y24% and foot at y56%. Side reveals are VISIBLE BROAD ANGLED SIDE WALLS with ribs, acoustic slats and metal service panels receding diagonally inward, also a visible overhead soffit, shadow under front girder, secondary smaller back truss. The stage deck upper surface is visibly a trapezoid with rear corners around (22%,56%) and (78%,56%) and front corners (13.5%,70%) and (86.5%,70%). The boards/cables/short panel seams recede all the way to the back and reinforce a roughly 1.5m setback. Front rectangular fascia from y70% to 78.4%, panelled in worn dark steel with selective low crimson edge lighting and recessed grilles; the unbroken foreground public walkway starts exactly at y78.4%, its front edge at 86.7% and cutaway structure below. Keep the exact outside walls in outermost 8% left/right, the top edge, and the whole original public foreground floor and lower cutaway. No steps, gap or obstacle blocking the public walking strip.
Art direction: rear backdrop recognizable worn abstract red three slash mark from image 1, somewhat smaller and less contrasty on far wall. Make the front portal heavier and darker than the back plane, alternate slats on returns with local red grazing light. Strong red neon practicals, a few dim muted plum secondary beams in back; no broad white beams, no mirror ball, no overall black-out. Broad industrial surfaces rather than microscopic noise. Same repaired navy-black steel bunker, no curtain, no huge concert arena. NO PEOPLE OR FREESTANDING OBJECTS at all: no drums, speakers, amps, chairs, guitar, microphone, crates, consoles. Bare structural built-in stage/deck and fixtures only. Preserve pixelated stepped silhouettes, limited coherent colours, orthographic frontal side-scroller camera outside the bay. The indentation is only onstage, not perspective down the hallway. No words, text, diagrams, frame lines, labels, HUD or borders.

Create ONE TRUE TRANSPARENT GAME PROP ATLAS of FOUR independent objects, 2 columns × 2 rows, row-major order. Reference 1 is the room/palette. Reference 2 is only the asset family's side-elevation pixel art scale and style, don't copy its catalog UI, letters or arrangement. Each object centered in its quadrant, huge transparent gutter between cells, complete silhouette including feet, no ground shadows, no colored backdrop, no fake checkerboard. No text anywhere.
Top left: ONE beat-up band venue check-in podium for the ENTRANCE, a narrow upright dark blue steel counter on the floor with one tiny dim plum credential screen on its sloping top, a couple of tape repairs. Whole podium, no door, no person, no floating sign.
Top right: ONE plain BAR STOOL with a small oxblood red vinyl seat, four black steel legs and a foot ring. No backrest or accessories. 
Bottom left: ONE spare worn ELECTRIC GUITAR held upright on a black floor stand, body wine red/cream pickguard, neck and headstock intact and stand legs and cradle complete. No player. 
Bottom right: ONE compact SOUND MIXING CONSOLE on a low rectangular flight-case table, recognizable rows of simple gray knobs/faders and tiny red/plum indicators, repaired steel corners. Whole coherent prop.
View directly from the side/front as in the actual side-scrolling game, very little top surface visible, stable horizontal baseline per sprite. All are stationary game props. Player stands 215 native pixels tall at 128 PPU. Slim one-to-two native pixel dark outlines, economical chunky contiguous flat shade shapes, three to five colours per material, deep graphite, gunmetal blue, burgundy, sparse warm metal and red/plum rim light, no blown white lights. Keep controls and materials readable when stool is 91 native pixels tall, podium 130, guitar 138 and console 105. Clear functional interiors; no high-resolution illustration noise, no sci-fi hazard text, no ornate glowing outlines, no logo. EXACTLY FOUR cutouts on alpha, no fifth item or extra variations.
